programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters head to Snow Pond to renovate a generational camp with a tight budget and deadline. Facing heat, supply issues, and surprises, they work hard -- yet still find time for games, laughs, and helping Ashley reconnect with an old friend.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Builder Chase Morrill, along with Ashley Morrill-Eldridge and Ryan Eldridge, his sister and brother-in-law, transform cabins in some of the most beautiful areas of Maine. From historic cottages to camp cabins, scenic retreats get the facelifts they need.

programs.title: Motel Rescue
programs.desc: In outdoors-obsessed Flagstaff, Ariz., Lindsey takes on a motel that used to be a hostel; she plans to lean into the communal aspects of the property and re-imagine the bedrooms to appeal to guests of this mountain city.
